title: LinkedIn Profile Assistant — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Improves professional profiles: headlines, summaries, experience. The LinkedIn Profile Assistant improves professional profiles and descriptions. It rewrites the headline to say what the student does and wants, sharpens the about section into a short professional story, and turns experience entries into achievement bullets with numbers. The profile starts attracting the right viewers instead of sitting empty.
capabilities: Rewrite headlines for clarity and keywords
Align the profile with career goals

demo.title: Safety limits enforced
demo.code: const entries=[{job:'TA',verified:true},{job:'CEO Intern',verified:false}];const flagged=entries.filter(e=>!e.verified).map(e=>e.job);J({flagged,note:'unverified entries must be confirmed by the student'});assert(flagged.length===1&&flagged[0]==='CEO Intern','verify');
